name: Mixed Berry Smoothie
steps: Stir chia seeds into 60 ml of the milk and leave for 10 minutes to swell. Slice the peeled banana.
Blend frozen berries, banana, yogurt and remaining 160 ml milk until the fruit is fully crushed and the mixture is smooth.
Add the swollen chia and honey, pulse briefly and taste; add a little more milk only if too thick to pour.
Divide among four glasses and serve cold while the berry flavour remains bright.
tips: Use unsweetened frozen berries to control the smoothie’s sweetness.
notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.
